0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The well-dressed noblewoman wishes to make an apology.

26.original: Deliver the letter of contrition to the fearful fugitive.

48.original: Oh, I-I'm not here to cause trouble! I've simply come to pay a visit to one of Amity's residents.

49.original: A former maidservant, in fact, to whom I owe a belated apology. But now that I've finally found her, I find myself beset with unease...

50.original: Before I approach, I need to know her state of mind─how does she feel now about Eulmore? About me? I would appreciate any insight that might better prepare me for what I must do...

51.original: Pray find my former maidservant, and ask for her thoughts on Eulmore. She's a young and pretty Hume girl, with hair the color of the palest rose...

53.original: You...want to know how I feel about Eulmore and my former masters? I thought I made that quite clear the last time we met: the very mention of that place leaves me shaking in terror.

54.original: It is a terrible city filled with terrible people, who care for naught but indulging their basest instincts...

55.original: Eulmore was a nightmare from which I've escaped in body only. I long for the day my mind is released from this fear...

56.original: And? What did she have to say of Eulmore...?

57.original: ...Trembles at the very mention of it? Well, I suppose that is to be expected.

58.original: 'Tis all true. We lived in decadent abandon, seeking only to fulfill our whims and appetites. And when <hex:021A020203>she<hex:021A020103> became the object of my husband's desires, a jealous rage consumed me. All I could think of was making her suffer...

59.original: With Lord Vauthry gone, 'tis almost as if a fog has lifted from my mind. How clearly I see now the awful person I had become.

60.original: My husband, too, regrets his behavior. He has made his apologies...and it is time for me to make mine.

61.original: ...Yet it seems a sudden confrontation may be ill-advised.

62.original: Anticipating such, I have penned a brief letter to explain my intentions. Pray deliver this to the girl─I shall be waiting at Top Rung.

64.original: ...Good gracious, this is from my old mistress!

65.original: (-Letter of Contrition-)<hex:021A020203>My dear girl, you served my husband and me with unrelenting diligence. And we repaid your efforts with vulgarity and violence, wounding you in heart and body alike.<hex:021A020103>

66.original: (-Letter of Contrition-)<hex:021A020203>I am deserving of your hatred. Of your fear. Words of apology can do little to salve the suffering I've caused, yet I would speak them nonetheless. I await your pleasure at Top Rung...<hex:021A020103>

68.original: Am I to believe she has changed so dramatically...?

71.original: Vauthry's society brought out the worst in people...

72.original: Hm. I'm not entirely convinced...but I will at least hear what she has to say.

73.original: Oh, and this is for you─her ladyship included a token of thanks for her “mediator.” I suppose I should be on my way...
